consumer: Existing interval judgment in the installed Bound instrument
unit: one physical byte of one uncompressed standing payload
model: Each declared world is a separate question world/standing-bytes/<world>. The same unchanged interval applies independently to each question; sizes are not added across worlds, requests, Root history, blobs or unrelated files.
reason: The unqualified built-in bytes measure selects the Root's own aggregate byte count before scoped observations. This qualified measure identifies the intended producer and unit, retaining the existing numeric ceiling.
integrity: Require exactly one pin for each selected world, payload presence and a matching digest before emitting the complete reading. Missing, changed or ambiguous selected input refuses; it never becomes zero.
overflow: Measure a valid pinned oversize payload honestly; the existing Bound interval judgment detects it. The reader does not compare against the ceiling or authorize an exception.
runtime: No change to Head adoption, transport, cache, authority or dependency code. The reading is evidence about the declared pinned payloads; it is not a new general transport guarantee or permission to fetch a URL.
claimsExcluded: runtime behavior under an invalid or locally modified pin policy
selection: Only the worlds explicitly selected by world/adopts are consumed. Unselected pins are not charged. An explicitly empty selection reads zero; a missing or ambiguous selection refuses.
